data.description: Learn the fundamentals of sync-sound moving image production, including directing, cinematography, lighting, sound recording, production design, color grading, and production logistics. Produce scenes from existing scripts, rotating through the positions of director, director of photography, production designer/camera assistant, gaffer, sound designer/mixer, and boom operator/editor. Gain experience in casting, location scouting, and set design. Develop a deeper understanding of crew dynamics, the art of storytelling, and the operation of digital cinema technologies essential to film and television/streaming drama.
data.title: FILMING ON SET: FILM & TELEVISION WORKSHOP

data.description: Learn to create film, video, and television content from script to screen through a hands-on introduction to the principles and practices of media production. Gain skills in screenwriting, videography, production design, editing and more, while engaging with various approaches to visual storytelling.
data.title: INTRODUCTION TO FILM AND TV PRODUCTION

data.description: Teaches the skills needed to produce, engage with, and understand new and emerging technologies within the context of communication and creative expression. Become a more critical consumer and producer of digital media.
data.title: INTRODUCTION TO DIGITAL MEDIA PRODUCTION
